purpose: Source-pinned public Apple security-advisory inventory for iOS 26. This is an evidence ledger, not an exploitability assessment.
completeness_policy: Do not mark a release complete until the advisory page has been fully parsed and its extracted CVE IDs have been reconciled against the page. Search snippets and partial page extracts are leads only.

target_context.target_applicability: not established by public advisory presence alone

limitations: Empty cve_ids arrays mean extraction is not yet completed, not that the release has no CVEs.
A CVE listed in an advisory does not establish applicability to the reported device/build, exploitability, or a usable jailbreak chain.
Public advisories omit undisclosed issues and may not provide enough detail to reproduce a vulnerability.
Do not infer exploit reliability, primitive availability, mitigation bypasses, or chainability from CVE metadata alone.
